name: Brute

Brute; Once per turn, when you push or knock a creature prone, deal bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier. descriptionMarkdown:
Brute; Once per turn, when you hit with a melee weapon, deal +1d6 damage.

Brute; Your Brute damage becomes +1d8.

Brute; Once per turn, when you push or knock a creature prone, deal bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier.

Brute; Your melee critical hits knock targets prone if they fail a Strength save.
